tools.name: where_was_it_filmed
tools.description: Returns every place recorded for a film, series, game, anime or manga, with coordinates, plus the countries recorded too coarsely to place. Covers 45,158 productions across 41,131 places. Films and series are placed where they were filmed (Wikidata P915). Video games, anime and manga are filmed nowhere, so they are placed where they are set (P840); the `relation` field of each record says which. A filled `countries_only` list means Wikidata records the production in those countries without a finer place. Places named only in the production's own Wikipedia article come in separate fields prefixed `wiki_`. The data records that a production was filmed at a place, not which scene was shot there.

title.description: Title, or its slug, e.g. "Skyfall", "game-of-thrones", "The Third Man"

tools.name: search_productions
tools.description: Finds productions by name, ignoring accents and case, best match first, then by how widely Wikipedia covers them. An optional filter by kind: film, tv, game, anime or manga. Each result carries its kind, its year and a `relation` field: films and series are placed where they were filmed, games, anime and manga where they are set.

query.description: Title or part of one, e.g. "bond", "star wars"

tools.name: what_was_filmed_here
tools.description: Returns everything recorded as made at a place, most widely covered first. Takes the place as a slug (e.g. "skellig-michael") or as a name. Each result carries a `relation` field, because a video game, an anime or a manga tied to a place is set there, not filmed there.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Finds filming locations by name, optionally filtered by country (a name or a two letter ISO code) and by kind of place. Results are ordered by fame rank, which comes from the most widely covered production shot there rather than from the place itself.

query.description: Place name or part of one, e.g. "skellig", "petra"

category.description: Kind of place, as a key or a slug: studio (Studios & sets), castle (Castles & palaces), landmark (Landmarks & buildings), street (Streets & squares), nature (Landscapes & nature), city (Towns & cities), region (Countries & regions), fiction (Fictional places) (optional)

tools.name: locations_near
tools.description: Lists the filming locations within a radius of a WGS84 coordinate, most famous first, each with its `distance_km`: what was filmed near a point. The radius defaults to 50 km (at most 500). Takes a latitude and a longitude in degrees; it does not look up place names.

category.description: Kind of place, as a key or a slug: studio (Studios & sets), castle (Castles & palaces), landmark (Landmarks & buildings), street (Streets & squares), nature (Landscapes & nature), city (Towns & cities), region (Countries & regions), fiction (Fictional places) (optional)

tools.name: top_locations
tools.description: Ranks the places in the atlas, worldwide or inside one country or one kind of place. The default order is fame rank, which comes from the most widely covered production shot there, so rank 1 is the place the most famous production used, not the place with the most credits. With `sort` set to `productions` the order is by number of productions (Los Angeles, New York, Vancouver).

country.description: Country name or two letter ISO code (optional; without it the ranking is worldwide)

category.description: Kind of place, as a key or a slug: studio (Studios & sets), castle (Castles & palaces), landmark (Landmarks & buildings), street (Streets & squares), nature (Landscapes & nature), city (Towns & cities), region (Countries & regions), fiction (Fictional places) (optional)

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Lists every country in the atlas with its number of filming locations, most first. Countries with a page on the site carry its URL. The counts reflect what Wikidata records, which is uneven and skewed to Europe and North America: they are records, not an inventory of world film production.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Headline figures computed live from the atlas: totals by medium and by kind of place, the top countries, the busiest and the most famous locations, and how many productions Wikidata records only at country level and so cannot place.
